_doc: Rules of graph.extract.ts_generic for Java (only dyn so far: the reflection and class loading calls whose argument is a string literal). dyn.name: Class.forName("p.Plugin"), loader.loadClass("p.Plugin"), findClass, getMethod("run"), getDeclaredMethod, getField, getDeclaredField name a class or a member by a literal: the D-tier site is `name:<simple name>` (the part after the last . or $), every def of that name may be used by reflection.
